AdvanceIn.description:
Exactly one of `to` and `step`. `to` at or before `revealed_through` answers an empty delta; `to` past
the window end is clamped and `at_end` is true. `step: "next_signal"` reveals through the next would-fire bar
close (a strategy-testing tool: it tells her a signal is coming); with none left it answers 422.
AdvanceIn.title: AdvanceIn

AdvanceOut.description:
What the playhead revealed in `(previous, revealed_through]`: display-interval bars that closed inside
it, the forming bar, the prints (size-filtered, capped), the would-fire signals whose bar closed inside it,
and the levels, last print and open trade at the new playhead.
AdvanceOut.title: AdvanceOut

BoardRowOut.description:
One name of the board, every figure read from daily bars through the prior close. A row with no data keeps its
place with empty figures.
BoardRowOut.title: BoardRowOut

CandidateOut.description: One name on the list, as of `data_through`. `list_price` is the price at the evaluating filter's cut.
CandidateOut.title: CandidateOut

CurvePointOut.description: A point of the balance curve: `n` 0 is the starting balance (no day), then one per ended day.
CurvePointOut.title: CurvePointOut

DailyBlockOut.description:
The Daily chart: the rebased bars through the session before the day (never the day's own), the forming candle
built from revealed one-minute bars, and this name's open hold for the entry marker and the stop line.
DailyBlockOut.title: DailyBlockOut

DailyOut.description: The hub's daily-list card: her plan and cursor, and her active day thread (balance and stats).
DailyOut.title: DailyOut

DayListOut.description:
One practice day. Before `status` is `ended` nothing here is later than `data_through` (the list, the stars,
Peek) or the day clock; `review` and `journal` are null until then.
DayListOut.title: DayListOut

DayListPatch.description:
PATCH body: the stars (at most five names from the list), notes, and the self-rating. A key left out is left
alone; `null` clears notes and rating.
DayListPatch.title: DayListPatch

EarningsChipOut.description: An explicit report date and timing within the next ten sessions. Never a guess from a gap (02p a3 rule 9).
EarningsChipOut.title: EarningsChipOut

FeedOut.title: FeedOut

FocusUntradedOut.description: A name she starred and never held: where it would have ranked as a long from the star day on.
FocusUntradedOut.title: FocusUntradedOut

FormingBarOut.description: The current display bar built from revealed closed 1-minute bars; it updates once a minute.
FormingBarOut.title: FormingBarOut

HoldOut.description:
A practice hold as the screens read it. Days are numbers and weekdays, never dates. An open hold carries
`unrealized_usd`, a closed one `pnl_usd`; `price_basis` says which price an open one is valued at.
HoldOut.title: HoldOut

HoldsOut.description: The thread's holds. Open ones are marked at the LAST ENDED day's close, never later (`as_of_day_no`).
HoldsOut.title: HoldsOut

JournalOut.description:
Live while the session is active (realized plus the open trade marked at the playhead); final after
`end`. `signals_vs_trades` and the 15/30-minute changes look past the playhead, so they are empty until
the session has ended.
JournalOut.title: JournalOut

LibraryExampleOut.description: A real occurrence on stored bars (the stub's snapshot here); the mock draws it as an example.
LibraryExampleOut.title: LibraryExampleOut

LibraryItemOut.description: One catalog entry, as `PresetCatalogV1` ships it, plus whether it can be attached.
LibraryItemOut.title: LibraryItemOut

ListUniverseOut.description: What was scanned. `label` and `footnote` state the universe plainly; show them beside any score.
ListUniverseOut.title: ListUniverseOut

Metrics.description: The snapshot's metric names, exactly (02m §a1). Numbers or null, never NaN.
Metrics.title: Metrics

OpenNextOut.description:
`day_list_id` is null while the plan's data is still being prepared (poll `GET /replay/daily`) and once every
day is done.
OpenNextOut.title: OpenNextOut

OpenTradeOut.description:
The name's open trade. For a swing session it is the name's practice hold (`trade_no` is the hold id) and the
four last fields say how long it has been held and which price it is valued at; a day session leaves them out.
OpenTradeOut.title: OpenTradeOut

PaceOut.description: Eligible prints and shares per market second over the last `window_s` seconds before the playhead.
PaceOut.title: PaceOut

PausedOut.description:
A stop was crossed: the playhead stopped at the close of the first one-minute bar that did (02p b5). It is a
pause, never an exit. `also` lists every other hold crossed in the same minute.
PausedOut.title: PausedOut

PeekOut.description:
Pre-open chart data for one candidate, cut at `data_through`: the same rebased daily bars the list was
screened on, and the day's minutes through the cut.
PeekOut.title: PeekOut

PracticePlanOut.description:
The saved daily-list plan and its cursor. `next_*` is the day Continue opens (the current one while it is
not over); `finished` is true once every day has ended. Dates are returned and hidden by a render rule.
PracticePlanOut.title: PracticePlanOut

ReplayDayOut.description:
One notable day. Spoiler-free: only what a trader knows at the open (the gap) plus non-directional heat
(volatility rank, heavy volume). Never the day's change, range, close, or close location.
ReplayDayOut.title: ReplayDayOut

ReplaySessionPatch.description: PATCH body: notes and the self-rating only.
ReplaySessionPatch.title: ReplaySessionPatch

ReplaySessionSummaryOut.description: A row of the hub's Resume card and Recent sessions table.
ReplaySessionSummaryOut.title: ReplaySessionSummaryOut

ReviewOut.description: Every candidate's move from its list price to the window end and the close. Only present once the day ended.
ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut

SettingsChannelStateOut.description:
`locked` is true only for the inbox, and `configured` is false until the owner wires the
channel's key. The inbox row is sent without `configured`, and telegram/slack without `locked`
(the endpoint uses `response_model_exclude_unset`), which is the a3.8 example shape.
SettingsChannelStateOut.title: SettingsChannelStateOut

Stamp.description: Embedded in every response that carries market data; the UI never computes freshness.
Stamp.title: Stamp

StripRowOut.description:
A row of the day strip: every open hold, then the focus names, at most ten. `last` is the last revealed regular
session price at the DAY CLOCK; `chg_pct` is against the restated prior close.
StripRowOut.title: StripRowOut

SwingDayListOut.description:
One swing day: the board as of the prior close, her focus names, the holds pinned above it and the day clock.
`kind` is always `"swing"`: it tells this model from `DayListOut`. Nothing here is later than the prior close or the
day clock until `status` is `ended`, when `journal` carries the day's summary.
SwingDayListOut.title: SwingDayListOut

SwingDaySummaryOut.description:
The strip of tiles an ended day serves (02p b6): the equity change split into realized, overnight gap and
intraday, with the holds as they stood at the close.
SwingDaySummaryOut.title: SwingDaySummaryOut

SwingEquityPointOut.description: One ended swing day of the equity series: numbers and a weekday only, no dates (the web hides them).
SwingEquityPointOut.title: SwingEquityPointOut

SwingOpenNextOut.description:
`POST /daily/next` for a swing thread. `day_list_id` is null while the prep runs (poll `GET /threads/{id}`) and
once every day is done.
SwingOpenNextOut.title: SwingOpenNextOut

SwingPeekOut.description: Pre-open chart data for one name: daily bars through the prior close, never a minute of the day.
SwingPeekOut.title: SwingPeekOut

SwingPlanOut.description: A swing thread's calendar cursor and prep. No dates: `next_day_no` and `next_weekday` only.
SwingPlanOut.title: SwingPlanOut

SwingStateOut.description:
Where a swing thread is (02p f2): the day under way (else the next to open), its week, the open holds with free
cash and equity, and the equity series, which stops at the last ended day. All SIMULATED.
SwingStateOut.title: SwingStateOut

SwingUniversePreviewIn.description:
What the setup form sends: the dates, her lists and filters, the fill rule, the hand edits and the target size.
Nothing is written; the first call starts the data prep for the symbols still missing.
SwingUniversePreviewIn.title: SwingUniversePreviewIn

SwingUniversePreviewOut.title: SwingUniversePreviewOut

ThreadBriefOut.description:
The header strip of a day screen or the workspace: the SIMULATED balance and today's realized P/L (null when no
practice day is under way; an open trade is not realized). A swing thread adds its equity, free cash and where it
is in its calendar (02p); a day thread leaves those null.
ThreadBriefOut.title: ThreadBriefOut

ThreadDayOut.description: One ended practice day, in the order she practised. `balance` is the SIMULATED balance at the day's end.
ThreadDayOut.title: ThreadDayOut

ThreadLedgerOut.description: The newest ledger rows, newest first. `total` counts every row.
ThreadLedgerOut.title: ThreadLedgerOut

ThreadSummaryOut.description:
A thread with its plan and stats (the contract), and today. A row of the hub's "Your threads" list. A swing
thread also carries its `swing` state (its setup is `thread.swing`, the contract's echo).
ThreadSummaryOut.title: ThreadSummaryOut

ThreadTodayOut.description: The practice day under way and what it has realized so far.
ThreadTodayOut.title: ThreadTodayOut

UniverseExcludedOut.description: One neutral reason that names no date, so the list reveals nothing about what happened later.
UniverseExcludedOut.title: UniverseExcludedOut

UniverseRowOut.description: A symbol of the table, every figure as of `basis_day`. `warnings` is plain words ("below floor").
UniverseRowOut.title: UniverseRowOut

WatchCheckOut.description:
"Traded only names on your watch": data for the screen to render. `traded` is the names she entered a trade on;
`off_watch` the ones she had not starred. Nothing scores it.
WatchCheckOut.title: WatchCheckOut

WatchlistOrder.description: `PUT /api/desk/watchlists/{id}/order`: the list's own symbols in their new order.
WatchlistOrder.title: WatchlistOrder

WeekHoldOut.description: A hold active in the week, scored against the universe over its span (02p e2).
WeekHoldOut.title: WeekHoldOut

WeekOut.description: A frozen review, or "Week to date" (`to_date` yes) for the open week through the last ended close.
WeekOut.title: WeekOut

WeekPatch.description: PATCH body: notes and the self-rating only. A key left out is left alone; `null` clears it.
WeekPatch.title: WeekPatch

WeekReviewOut.description:
The review of one week (02p e1), as `week.compute_review` builds it. `lines` is the key `copy` on the wire (a
field cannot be called `copy`): the sentences the screen shows under the tiles.
WeekReviewOut.title: WeekReviewOut

WeekTilesOut.description: The review's tiles. A figure that cannot be computed is null, never a guess.
WeekTilesOut.title: WeekTilesOut

Response List Alert Strategy Fires Api Desk Alert Strategies  Strategy Id  Fires Get
Response List Alerts Api Desk Alerts Get

get.description:
Closed bars for the chart. `ext` marks pre/after-hours bars; `stamp` is the freshness the UI shows.
Stub (`DESK_MVP_STUB=1`): SPY, NVDA, MSFT from the snapshot, `session=extended` reads the Friday 5m series.

Pattern markers on closed bars (drawn below the bar) plus the fires of her strategies (a bell above),
filtered to `from`..`to` on the bar start for patterns and the bar time for fires.

schema.title: Response Futures Specs Api Desk Futures Specs Get
Response List Library Api Desk Library Get

get.description:
Server-sent events, one connection per symbol. Each `quote` event's data is JSON:
`{"symbol", "close", "quality", "as_of", "freshness", "source", "session"}`.
`as_of` is the closed 1m bar's start (`+00:00`, `Z` in the stub).
`freshness` is live|delayed|closed|paused|unavailable; `source` is the bar's provider;
`session` is pre|regular|after|closed (the market session now).
An event is sent only when the quote changes; the stream stays open until the client disconnects.
Stub: one event for SPY, NVDA or MSFT from the last 15m fixture bar, then the stream stays open.

The hub's daily-list card: her plan and where its cursor is, and her active day thread with its SIMULATED balance
and stats; either is `null` before she has one.

post.description:
Open the next day's list, or continue the current one. A body with a `plan` (a `PracticeBlockV1`) first saves
that plan, replacing hers, and starts preparing its data in the background. While the data is not ready the
answer carries no `day_list_id`; poll `GET /replay/daily`. Days open in order, one at a time.

A new plan binds to a practice thread: `threadId`, else her active day thread (a closed or missing one is a 409
in plain words). The thread, not the plan, carries the risk plan (D-007): `setup.plan` and `setup.shares` from an
old client are ignored.

`{"threadId": n}` alone continues a SWING thread's calendar (it has no plan to send: its universe is frozen with the
thread) and answers `kind: "swing"`; with a day thread it is the same plain 422 as before.

schema.title: Response Open Next Api Desk Replay Daily Next Post

get.description:
One practice day: the frozen candidate list as of `data_through`, her stars, the day clock, the day's
session, and (with `peek`) the pre-open chart data of one candidate. The review and the day journal are null
until the day has ended. A swing thread's day is the board as of the prior close (`SwingDayListOut`).

schema.title: Response Get Day List Api Desk Replay Day Lists  Day List Id  Get

patch.description: Stars (at most five names from the list, each stamped with the day clock), notes and the self-rating.

schema.title: Response Patch Day List Api Desk Replay Day Lists  Day List Id  Patch

post.description:
End the day: the open practice trade exits at the last price, the window unseals, and the list review
(every candidate's move from its list price) is stored and served. Idempotent. A swing day exits nothing: the open
holds are marked at the close, and a day with no session is a Pass.

schema.title: Response End Day Api Desk Replay Day Lists  Day List Id  End Post

post.description:
Practise one name from the list, built from the plan's setup, starting at the day clock. One name a day in
v1: another name is a 409 until the day ends. A swing day allows several names on its shared clock.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api Desk Replay Sessions Get

post.description:
Start a practice session from a `ReplaySessionV1`: validates the day and its data, snapshots the armed
strategy versions, and computes the would-fire signals (held back until the playhead reaches them). One
active session per symbol and day: a second POST returns the existing one; after `end` it is attempt n + 1.

patch.description: Notes and the self-rating only; a key left out is left alone, `null` clears it.

post.description: Auto-exit an open trade at the last price, reveal the whole window, and store the final journal. Idempotent.
Place a practice mark at the playhead: the server stamps the time and the last print's price.

delete.description: Undo the last mark, only while the playhead has not moved since it was placed (else 409).

get.description: Her threads, the active ones first, each with its plan, stats and today (the hub's resume list).

schema.title: Response List Threads Api Desk Replay Threads Get

post.description:
Start a practice thread from a `PracticeThreadCreateV1`: a SIMULATED starting balance (default 50,000), the
risk plan, and the mode (`day`, or `swing` with its `swing` block). One active thread per mode: a second is a 409.
A swing thread freezes its universe and calendar here, after the days, the data and the arms check out (every
rejection is a plain problem), and starts preparing its bars in the background.

The universe table of a swing thread's setup form (02p c1), every figure as of the close before the first day.
Nothing is saved but the bar cache. Her own picks are fetched first; what the request's time budget could not reach
is `pending` and fetched in the background, so the form calls this again while `state` is `preparing`.

get.description:
One thread: its plan, stats, today, the daily P/L series (one row per ended day) and the balance curve. Every
figure is read back from the ledger; nothing is stored twice.

patch.description:
Replace the risk plan while the thread is active (a closed thread is a 409). It applies from the next session:
a session already started keeps the plan it began with.

post.description:
Close the thread: its daily plan is archived and its plan and balance freeze. An open practice day is a 409 (end
it first). A swing thread's open holds exit at the last ended close and its open week is frozen with its review.
Idempotent.

get.description:
The thread's practice holds in entry order, each with its P/L. An open hold is marked at the LAST ENDED day's
close, never at a later price.
The thread's realized practice trades (`PracticeLedgerEntryV1`), newest first: the rows its balance is of.
One row per week opened so far: its days, status and the headline figures of its review.

The frozen review of a finished week, or "Week to date" (`to_date` is `yes`) for the open one, computed on read
through the last ended close. A week that has not started, or has no finished day yet, is a 404.

patch.description: Notes and the self-rating of a week; a key left out is left alone, `null` clears it.

schema.title: Response List Filters Api Desk Screener Filters Get

get.description:
The filter's newest stored run. Before its first run it answers 200 with no matches and an
`unavailable` stamp (no `as_of`), so the screen can say "Waiting for the first scan" without an error.

post.description:
Evaluate an unsaved spec over the stored universe, never a provider, within `PREVIEW_BUDGET_SECONDS`.
Over budget it answers `matches_total: null` and no `top` (a partial ranking would mislead).

Response List Signals Api Desk Signals Get

get.description:
The desk's technical view for one timeframe. Stub (`DESK_MVP_STUB=1`): SPY, NVDA, MSFT from the snapshot;
`gauges.strategies` is a sample for NVDA 15m only. Real mode computes everything from the bars: the last
values (`indicators`), the bias history and its newest change, the key `levels`, and the fourth gauge from
her strategies (null with none on this timeframe).
